Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

A vertical medium shot of a young East Asian woman with fair skin and long, dark hair styled in an elegant updo adorned with a large cluster of white hydrangea flowers. She is wearing a white, short-sleeved Chinese-style dress (Qipao) featuring subtle blue floral patterns and orange piping along the collar and cuffs. Her body is angled slightly to the left, but her head is turned to face the camera directly with a soft, gentle smile and a gaze that looks slightly upward. Her right hand is raised to her cheek in a delicate pose, while her left arm rests naturally by her side. The background consists of a traditional white wooden window frame with a geometric, lattice design, through which dappled sunlight filters, casting intricate shadows of leaves on the wall behind her. In the upper right corner, green bamboo leaves hang down into the frame. The lighting is bright and natural, creating a high-key, airy atmosphere with soft highlights on her face and clothing. The color palette is dominated by whites, creams, and pale greens, accented by the orange trim and the dark hair. The aesthetic is ethereal, classical, and serene, reminiscent of traditional Chinese portraiture or a vintage fashion editorial.
